snippet.title: Path of Exile: Keepers of the Flame Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
On October 23rd PDT, we’ll be announcing our next expansion for Path of Exile 1. GGG Live will begin at 12PM on October 23 (PDT) at twitch.tv/pathofexile!

Wield the Flame and fight back the hiveborn! You'll be able to play the Keepers of the Flame expansion for free on PC and Consoles on October 31st (PDT).
